assertions.name: floor_three_unreached_at_the_meson_cap
assertions.source: Best floor found among words of length 14. Ito needs 3. Recorded as the measured number so a future run that finds a floor-3 word fails loudly rather than silently agreeing.

assertions.name: exhaustive_below_length_eight
assertions.source: Lengths 1..7 are enumerated in full; beyond that 4^L makes enumeration infeasible and the result is a search, not a proof.

description: Asks whether the framework's short braid vocabulary is load-bearing or incidental, by combining the corpus's own crossing-number arithmetic (crossing number = sum of constituent generation windings, from {3,5,7}) with a measurement of which Dehornoy floors are reachable at each word length. Integer arithmetic only.

crossing_number_is_a_quantum_number.source_lean: QOU/ParticleInteractions/WeakIsospinT3Grading.lean, sorry-free: signedWrithe up 3 / charm 5 / top 7, genWinding = |signedWrithe|
crossing_number_is_a_quantum_number.source_block: knots-particles-confinement/lepton-meson-torus-knot-dictionary-proof.md: 'K: u-bar s = 3 + 5 = 8 crossings', 'eta, phi: s-bar s = 5 + 5 = 10 crossings'
crossing_number_is_a_quantum_number.consistency_check: the corpus meson braid M = (s0 s1)^2 s1 s0 has 6 crossings, and the pion is u-bar d = 3 + 3 = 6 -- the arithmetic reproduces the written word
crossing_number_is_a_quantum_number.nine_is_the_gluon: T(2,9) is the genus-4 saturating force carrier, not a quark generation, so 9 is unavailable as a constituent winding

finding.reading: Floor 3 is not reached at any length up to the framework's meson cap of 14 crossings; the best found there is 2. Floor 3 appears at 18 crossings (Delta^6). So the short-word vocabulary is LOAD-BEARING: Ito's hypothesis is not merely unmet by the candidates written so far, it is unreachable by any meson braid this framework admits, because crossing number is a quantum number capped at 7+7.

scope.class: (a) scope-limited, on a SEARCH plus a corpus premise
scope.claimed: No B_3 word of length <= 14 was FOUND with Dehornoy floor 3, exhaustively up to length 7 and by 40000-word sampling beyond; and the corpus's own arithmetic caps a meson braid at 14 crossings.
scope.NOT_claimed: That no such word EXISTS -- beyond length 7 this is sampling, not enumeration. That the cap is a theorem: 'crossing number = sum of constituent windings' is the corpus's stated construction, taken as given here, not re-derived. And the Dehornoy floor is not a conjugacy invariant, so this is about WORDS, not the link types they close to.
scope.what_would_overturn_it: A meson whose braid is not the sum of two constituent windings, a fourth generation winding above 7, or an exhaustive search at length 8-14 finding a floor-3 word.

data.verdict: The short-word vocabulary is LOAD-BEARING, not incidental. Crossing number in this framework is a quantum number -- the sum of two constituent generation windings from {3,5,7} -- so a meson braid is capped at 14 crossings. Measured, Dehornoy floor 3 is not reachable at that length (best found 2); it first appears at 18. So Ito's Theorem 2 cannot apply to ANY meson braid this framework admits, and the same length ceiling is why Giambrone's family excludes the corpus's carriers. The closed-3-braid geometric literature is built for complex braids; this framework structurally cannot supply one. That is a statement about applicability, not about whether Obstruction A is soluble -- it stays open, and now with one fewer route worth importing.
